title: hierarchy/<school>/pis.json
description: The school's PIs: one record per census faculty member who is a PI (reviewed exclusions removed), each with one own lab.
x-writer: tools/pi_hierarchy.py (tools/pihier/census.py, identity.py, build.py); atlas ids by tools/atlas_ids.py

pi.description: One PI: the merged census rows, reviewed corrections, identity, appointment evidence, own lab and counts.
The PI's name as the census gives it; the key of the lab everywhere in the package.

personIds.description: The PI's collection person id (at most one), when the census or an override names one that exists in the collection.

names.description: Every name form the matchers use: census name, aliases (census + overrides), the collection person name.

dblp.description: DBLP person pages of the PI (census, overrides, gap identity; a name-mismatched pid dropped, a unique exact-name pid added).

reviewedOpenAlex.description: Reviewed OpenAlex author ids of the PI (census + census-overrides + gap-evidence identity).

orcid.description: The PI's ORCIDs (bare, without https://orcid.org/), including those added from the DBLP dump.

notOpenAlex.description: Reviewed namesake author ids: never this PI (census-overrides not_openalex).

mixedOpenAlex.description: Reviewed mixed author ids: another person's record that also holds some of the PI's works; neither anchors nor blocks.

mergedCensusRows.description: Names of the further census rows merged into this PI (duplicate pairs, nickname-equal given names).

title.description: The title as listed by the census (title_as_listed).

departments.description: Departments or units the census lists the PI in.

piBasis.description: Why this person is a PI: the reviewed basis from census-overrides.json pi_basis, else the census row's pi_basis (free-form record: kind, url, sha256, quote, observed, ...; kind 'advises_phd' quotes feed pi_basis_advising students).

kind.description: The kind of basis (census vocabulary, open).

lab.description: The PI's own lab: a collection lab unit led by this PI alone (reused), else a new own lab.

unitId.description: The reused collection unit id; null for a new own lab.

name.description: The lab's name: the unit's, a proposed non-collective unit's, else '<PI> group'.

basis.description: single_leader_unit: a census lab unit with this PI as its single leader; new_own_lab otherwise.

url.description: The proposed unit url or the census profile url (new own labs only).

evidence.description: The proposed lab unit's evidence, else the census row's pi_basis (free-form census record: kind, url, sha256, quote, ...).

collectives.description: Census lab-unit ids the PI belongs to that are collectives (centers, institutes, multi-leader units), not labs (new own labs only).

periods.description: The PI's appointment periods at the school: collection faculty periods (up to two evidence items) and reviewed periods (census-overrides.json; an open reviewed period is current as of the build date).

listings.description: Dated department listings naming the PI as faculty, one per calendar year (2016-2026), without the stale years after a move.

listingsAfterMove.description: Listing years after an evidenced departure not covered by a later period: stale pages, not appointments.

orcidFromDblp.description: ORCIDs the DBLP dump added to this PI (subset of orcid).

dblpBasis.description: How a PI without a DBLP id got one: the unique DBLP person of that exact name.
enum: unique DBLP person of that exact name among the cached publication co-authors
unique DBLP person of that exact name in the DBLP dump

dblpDropped.description: DBLP pids dropped because the DBLP person name conflicts with the PI names.

oaAuthorIds.description: OpenAlex author ids anchored to the PI by the build (most anchoring works first).

funnel.description: Where the PI's name hits dropped out of the lab-paper rule (counts).

name_hits.description: Sweep authorships matching the PI name.

school_affiliated.description: Of those, with a school basis.

identity.description: Of those, with an identity anchor.

in_appointment.description: Of those, inside the appointment (lab-paper candidates before not-paper and edition steps).

page1_elsewhere.description: Unaffiliated-advisee route hits whose page 1 puts the authors elsewhere.

transition_year_outside.description: Unaffiliated hits on the wrong side of a transition-year listing capture.

dated_before_window.description: Deposits whose DBLP venue version predates 2016.

dblpTitles.description: Titles on the PI's DBLP lists.

dblpDois.description: DOIs on the PI's DBLP lists.

^outside_appointment_\\d{4}$.description: Hits outside the appointment, by publication year.

verifiedWorks.description: Verified collection works of the PI.

labPapers.description: Rows of lab_papers.jsonl.gz for this PI.

studentPaperLinks.description: Rows of student_papers.jsonl.gz for this PI.

atlasId.description: The PI's atlas person id (written by the ids stage; absent before it, e.g. an onboarding school).

appointments.description: Every atlas school where this person is a PI, with the lab id (cross-school PIs have 2+).

asStudent.description: This person's student records elsewhere in the atlas.

items.description: A student record of the same person.

period.description: An appointment period: a collection faculty period, or a reviewed one from census-overrides.json (which may carry extra review fields).

id.description: Period id (collection id, or override_period_<school>_<slug> for a reviewed period); lab papers cite it as appointment.periodId.

start.description: Start date: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD, optionally with a note in parentheses ('2020 (Fall)').

end.description: End date (same forms); null for an open period.

asof.description: For an open period: the date it was last confirmed (reviewed open periods without one get the build date).

rank.description: Rank held in the period (reviewed periods).

listing.description: A dated department listing that names the PI as faculty in one calendar year (census source or verified yearly listing).

url.description: The captured listing page (Wayback id_ capture for yearly listings).

sha256.description: sha256 of the captured listing bytes.

quote.description: The row of the listing that names the PI.

kind.description: Source kind; 'dept_listing:<department>' for the verified yearly listings (listings/<school>/listings.json).

year.description: The calendar year the listing proves (the capture year).

rank.description: The rank as listed (yearly listings only).

emeritus.description: The listing marks the PI emeritus (yearly listings only).

visiting.description: The listing marks the PI visiting (yearly listings only).

source.description: An evidence item: the page cited, the sha256 of the captured bytes and a verbatim quote (best_sources keeps complete items first).

sha256.description: sha256 of the captured bytes (64 lowercase hex digits).

quote.description: Verbatim text of the page that states the fact.

capture_url.description: The Wayback or local capture the hash and quote come from, when not the url itself.

kind.description: What kind of page (free text from the source collection, e.g. faculty_profile, dept_listing:EECS).

observed.description: When the page was seen (date or timestamp).

quote_field.description: 'statement' when the collection gave the quote as `statement` (MIT) and best_sources copied it into quote.
